messages.text:
Happy to. Which miner are you comparing against, and are you shopping for the best value or the smallest/quietest setup?

If you just want our picks: the Magic Miner 40T is $799 for 40 TH/s, about $20 per TH, and the Harlo B30 is $899 for 30 TH/s at 360 to 450 W. Those two beat everything else per terahash. In-stock small units like the Hammer BC04 ($239, 6 TH/s) cost more per TH but ship now.

B30 against the field, live prices:

Harlo B30, $899, 30 TH/s at 360 to 450 W, about 50 dB, BM1373 chips. Pre-sale, ships October 30.

Magic Miner 40T, $799, 40 TH/s at 650 W, tunable 30 to 50. Cheaper and faster, but it pulls more power. Ships November 14.

In stock now, the Hammer BC04 is $239 for 6 TH/s and the NerdOctaxe $359.99 for 12 TH/s. Both cost more per terahash.

Tell me your state or country and I'll run the actual sats and power cost for you.
